sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: Performance qualification is your own study, on your own calibrated parts, in your own process. It shows that the system, your machines, your programs and your people together give results you can rely on. Metrology Maven never runs or passes it for you; this template only helps you plan and record it.

sections.heading: Study plan
sections.text: Measure the reference part repeatedly under normal production conditions, with the usual operators, fixtures and programs, and compare each result with its calibrated value.
